images.madeBy: Alex Smith, for this bestax port
images.method: Drawn by code: docs/scripts/template-art/scenes/rent.mjs places every block and shape, and the voxel renderer in docs/scripts/template-art writes the SVG, with every texture generated from a palette and a seed. No photograph, stock image or other third-party image was used as an input or as a tracing reference.
images.depicts: A blocky street of three homes on a sidewalk: a white apartment block with a "For rent" sign, a narrow brick townhouse and a cream cottage with a green roof, with trees and a street lamp.
images.replaces: public/media/property_image.png, the original's hero illustration, whose source the original does not record.
